reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"type Issue = { number: number; state: string; labels: { name: string }[]; milestone: unknown; updated_at: string }; type Page = { items: Issue[]; next_page?: number | null }; const repo = 'acme/api'; const cutoff = Date.parse('2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'); const targets = new Set<number>(); const visited = new Set<number>(); let page: number | null | undefined = 1; while (page != null) { if (visited.has(page)) throw new Error(`Repeated page ${page}`); visited.add(page); const result = await tools.list_issues({repo, state:'open', label:'bug', page}) as Page; for (const issue of result.items) { if (issue.state === 'open' && issue.milestone === null && Date.parse(issue.updated_at) < cutoff && issue.labels.some(label => label.name === 'bug') && !issue.labels.some(label => label.name === 'stale')) targets.add(issue.number); } page = result.next_page; } return {pages: visited.size, targets: [...targets]};","answer":""}
